lines.beaver: 수아 씨, 왜 이렇게 늦었어요? 무슨 일 있었어요?
lines.beaver_en: Sua, why are you so late? Did something happen?
lines.beaver_roman: Sua ssi, wae ireoke neujeosseoyo? Museun il isseosseoyo?
lines.learner: 길에서 사고가 났어요. 어찌나 놀랐는지 몰라요.
lines.en: There was an accident on the road. I was so shocked.
lines.roman: Gireseo sagoga nasseoyo. Eojjina nollanneunji mollayo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Which way did you come?
lines.learner: 강남 방면으로 오다가 다리 건너에서 봤어요.
lines.en: I was heading toward Gangnam and saw it across the bridge.
lines.roman: Gangnam bangmyeoneuro odaga dari geonneoeseo bwasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of accident was it?
lines.learner: 오토바이가 왼편에서 와서 차 측면에 부딪혔어요.
lines.en: A motorbike came from the left and hit the side of a car.
lines.roman: Otobaiga oenpyeoneseo waseo cha cheungmyeone budichyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, was the person okay?
lines.en: The rider fell on the ground. I saw it right in front of me.

lines.learner: 네, 금방 왔고 사람들이 바쁘게 움직였어요.
lines.en: Yes, it came quickly and people moved busily.
lines.roman: Ne, geumbang watgo saramdeuri bappeuge umjigyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: So that's why the road was blocked. That way is narrow, right?
lines.learner: 네, 그 일대가 다 막혀서 걸어왔어요.
lines.en: Yes, the whole area was jammed, so I walked here.
lines.roman: Ne, geu ildaega da makyeoseo georeowasseoyo.

lines.en: It was near the corner of the park beyond the bridge.

lines.beaver_en: With so many cars, it must have been hard to see.
lines.learner: 네, 트럭이 시야를 가려서 잘 안 보였어요.
lines.en: Yes, a truck blocked my view, so I couldn't see well.
lines.roman: Ne, teureogi siyareul garyeoseo jal an boyeosseoyo.

lines.en: Yes, the police redirected cars to the back road.

lines.beaver_en: That was rough. The meeting starts in a bit.
lines.en: Thanks. It was so hectic, you have no idea.
